project_overview: CCTNS V1.0 is a police case management system focusing on crime investigation and criminal detection, providing value to police personnel and citizens.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Administrator with privileges to manage user profiles and system configurations

actors.name: PoliceOfficer
actors.description: Law enforcement personnel who investigate and manage cases

actors.name: Citizen
actors.description: Public user who may report cases or access limited case information

actors.name: HelpDesk
actors.description: Support staff who handle defect reports and enhancement requests

actors.name: Auditor
actors.description: External personnel who review system activity and audit trails

actors.name: RecordsStaff
actors.description: Staff responsible for maintaining case records

functions.name: ConfigureAccess
acceptance_criteria: Access rights are set correctly
Changes are logged in audit trail
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: ExportAuditTrail
functions.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
acceptance_criteria: Audit data is exported without affecting stored trail
Exported data contains all required information
Audit trail is exported without affecting stored data
Exported data is complete and accurate

functions.name: GenerateReport
functions.description: Generate reports on defects or cases
acceptance_criteria: Reports are generated accurately
Reports can be filtered by various criteria

functions.name: InvestigateCase
functions.description: Police initiates investigation process after complaint registration
acceptance_criteria: Case status is updated to 'Under Investigation'
All investigation actions are recorded in audit trail
Investigation details are recorded
Case status is updated appropriately

functions.name: LogDefect
functions.description: Log system defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: Defect is logged with all required details
User receives confirmation

functions.name: ManageUserProfile
acceptance_criteria: Profiles are created/updated accurately
Only admin users can perform this function
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: ProsecuteCase
acceptance_criteria: 能够记录与法庭的所有交互
能够跟踪案件起诉进度
Prosecution details are recorded
Case status is updated to reflect prosecution

functions.name: RegisterCase
functions.description: Citizens can register complaints with police
acceptance_criteria: Case is created with all required fields
Citizen receives confirmation of case registration
Case details are captured accurately
Case is assigned a unique identifier

functions.name: SearchCase
functions.description: Search for cases based on various criteria
acceptance_criteria: Search results are returned within performance requirements
Only cases with proper access rights are shown
能够按人员、犯罪类型、作案手法、财产等搜索
能够按案件或嫌疑人/被告自定义结果视图
能够执行月报、RTI相关等查询
Search results are returned within specified time limits
Only cases accessible to user are shown
functions.preconditions: User must have appropriate access rights

functions.name: TrackDefect
functions.description: Track submitted defects or enhancement requests
acceptance_criteria: Defect status updates are visible to submitter
Help desk can generate reports on defects
Defect status is accurately tracked
Users receive alerts on status changes

User searches for a case that doesn't exist or they can't access

exceptions.description: System fails to resize text as requested by the user.
exceptions.trigger: The user agent does not support text resizing or the system encounters an error.
exceptions.handling: Display a message indicating that text resizing is not supported and provide alternative options (e.g., zooming the entire page).

exceptions.description: System fails to send an alert when an action is taken on a defect.
exceptions.trigger: The system encounters an error while trying to send an alert (e.g., email server down).
exceptions.handling: Log the error in the audit trail and retry sending the alert at a later time. Notify the system administrator if the issue persists.
Continue operation in offline mode with limited functionality

exceptions.handling: Log attempt in audit trail, show appropriate error message

exceptions.handling: Log in audit trail and provide appropriate response based on configuration

exceptions.trigger: User tries to access a case they don't have permission for
exceptions.handling: Log in audit trail and show appropriate message

exceptions.description: User attempts to access a case that is not assigned to them.
exceptions.trigger: User tries to access a case they do not have permission to view.
exceptions.handling: Log the attempt in the audit trail and display a message indicating that access is denied.

exceptions.description: User attempts to customize UI beyond allowed parameters.
exceptions.trigger: User tries to modify UI elements that are not configurable.
exceptions.handling: Display an error message indicating which elements cannot be modified and provide a list of configurable options.

exceptions.description: User attempts to generate a report with invalid parameters.
exceptions.trigger: User provides invalid or conflicting parameters for report generation.
exceptions.handling: Display an error message with a list of valid parameters and examples of correct usage.
